en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘You cannot pray Salāt in what is gauzy or sieves, meaning the sparkling’. And it is reported: ‘(Heasws said): ‘You cannot pray Salāt in a black cloth, but as for the socks, or a cloak, or the turban, so there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 24. Muhammad ibn Yahya in a marfu‘ manner has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘You must not perform Salah (prayer) in cloths that are shaffa or suffa, that is, that which is painted.’” In another Hadith it is said, ‘Do not perform Salah (prayer) in black clothes; however, black slipper, cloak or turban is not harmful.’”
